coordinate_system.origin: centre of the overall plan bounding box (14,521 × 12,271 mm) at finished floor level (FFL ±0)
coordinate_system.threejs: Load scene.glb with GLTFLoader; no axis conversion required (glTF is +Y up, metres).

scroll_path.description: Scroll-driven camera path: aerial dollhouse → main entry → public zone → play room → hallway → kids → study → master suite → aerial top view.
scroll_path.interpolation: centripetal Catmull-Rom (THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points, false, "centripetal")) for both position and target; map scroll progress t∈[0,1] with the keyframe t values
scroll_path.threejs_snippet: const P=k.map(k=>new THREE.Vector3(...k.position_m)); const T=k.map(k=>new THREE.Vector3(...k.target_m)); const cp=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(P,false,'centripetal'); const ct=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(T,false,'centripetal'); // u = piecewise-linear map of scroll t onto keyframe index / (n-1)
